metadata.scenario: A retired teacher calls for the first time asking about companion care for herself. She lives alone and wants someone to check on her a few times a week. She asks about pricing and mentions she's on a fixed income so cost is a concern. The receptionist explains their most affordable options. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. My name is Rose Patterson. I’m calling to inquire about companion care services for myself. Hello, Rose! I’d be happy to help you with that. Can you tell me a little about what you’re looking for? Well, I live alone and would like someone to check on me a few times a week. Just for some company and help with daily tasks. That sounds great, Rose. We have companion care services that can fit your needs perfectly. That’s good to hear. What are the costs for that? I’m on a fixed income, so I need to keep budget in mind. Absolutely, I understand. Our companion care services range from $25 to $30 per hour. Would you be looking for a certain number of hours each week? Yes, maybe two or three visits a week for a couple of hours each time. That would come to about $150 to $180 per week, depending on the exact hours you choose. Hmm, I see. That’s a bit more than I hoped. Are there any options for less frequent visits? Certainly! You could schedule visits once a week, which would lower the overall cost. Would that be something you’d consider? Yes, I think I might need to do that. Great! We can adjust the schedule based on your comfort. Would you like to set up an initial visit? Yes, I’d like to know more about the caregivers as well. We ensure that our caregivers are matched to fit your preferences and needs. You would meet them during the initial visit. That sounds reassuring. When could we schedule that? Let me check our availability. I can schedule a visit for you as early as this Tuesday. Would that work? Yes, Tuesday sounds good. What time do you have available? How does 10 AM work for you? Perfect! Great! I’ll set that up for you. Before we wrap up, can I get your email address for confirmation? Sure, it’s rose.patterson@email.com. Thank you, Rose. I’ll send you a confirmation and more information. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help. My pleasure! If you have any other questions before our visit, feel free to call back. I will. Have a great day! You too, Rose! Take care.
